Celebrating our players

HBCC on the international stage

Congratulations to our HBCC juniors who represented Australia at the 24th annual ASEAN+ Chess Championships in Singapore.

ASEAN+ Championships
4×

Bronze medals for Australia

Across Classical, Rapid and Blitz — a fantastic achievement by our junior players.

Kaisar BatyrbekovU10 • Classical + Rapid
Nyra VenkatG08 • Classical
Aidan BatyrbekovU10 • Blitz
4

Junior Club Championship spots remain

Nine juniors are still battling for four remaining places through the final two rounds of the Koshnitsky R&J Cup.

  • Ashwin Ramanathan — qualified
  • Aidan Batyrbekov — qualified
  • Shreyansh Annadasu — qualified
  • Kaisar Batyrbekov — qualified
Confirmed qualifiers: email tournaments@hobsonsbaychess.com by 30 September.

Victorian Inter-Club Rapid — HBCC team plan
HBCC intends to enter two teams at Melbourne Chess Club on 22 November 2026:

  • HBCC Senior Team
  • HBCC Junior Team
International opportunities for Australian juniors
Commonwealth Schools Chess Championship 2026 (Malaysia), Asian Schools Chess Championships 2026 (Russia), FIDE World U7–U17 Championships 2026 (Spain), FIDE World Junior U20 Rapid & Blitz 2026 (UAE), and FIDE World U7–U17 Rapid & Blitz 2026 (Egypt). Expressions of interest: selections_director@auschess.org.au.
